native_mechanisms: Two rows on a shared track, one fixed, the other slipped forward one house at exactly one position (and once not at all) — n+1 single-gap offset trials instead of a grid
House-by-house petal/knot marking: +1 where beasts agree, -1 where they disagree, each house independent of every other (pure elementwise, one count per beat)
Each trial collapses to a single weight (knot count); all trials but the lightest are discarded — a max-reduction over trials, keeping only the score
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch (two-row int32 DP, band half-width w=(n-LB)/5+1 with full-DP fallback), where the native's single-slip SIMD/prefix-sum scan only supplies the lower bound LB that sizes the band.
